name: Listener
tagline: Sits in on Teams calls, then returns a transcript and a decisions-and-actions digest
description: It joins a Teams meeting as a visible, named attendee and captures the call audio. Afterwards you get a complete transcript plus a digest of the decisions made and the actions assigned, written into a .docx you can circulate as minutes. Everyone on the call can see that it is there.
author: berlu135
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
